caseScope: Shipped spreadsheet client executed in a synthetic DOM with controlled response sequences. This is client-state coverage, not actual browser or server deduplication evidence.

browser.expected: Actual committed writes, lost replies, later 403/409, unchanged retry keys/payloads, one source/project and no second revision.

boundary: A first-attempt 4xx remains a definite rejection. An earlier uncertain attempt is not cleared by a later refusal. Session expiry still clears private client state. A saved-project read with matching exact normalized values can confirm an update without another write.
